brief.goal: Connect Google Tasks via API with bidirectional sync, consolidating tasks into the unified task view with source badges.
brief.constraints: Electron desktop app (existing project), Google Tasks API OAuth2, bidirectional sync (create/complete/delete), source badge per task, Beta milestone (PDR-007), must integrate with existing task consolidation view.
brief.non_goals: M365 Graph connector, TickTick integration, TickTick bidirectional sync, LAN dashboard, onboarding consent flow, telemetry.
success_criteria: Google Tasks API OAuth2 connection works
Tasks from Google Tasks appear in consolidated task view
Bidirectional sync: create, complete, and delete propagate both ways
Source badge (Google Tasks) visible on each synced task

steps.prompt: Write a feature specification for the goal below. Include requirements, constraints, and measurable success criteria.
Break down the specification into an implementation plan with ordered, verifiable tasks.
Generate the detailed task list from the plan — each task must have exact file paths and verification steps.
Implement the next pending task from the plan. Follow test-driven practices.
Review the implementation against the specification and success criteria. Verify independently — you are the checker, not the maker.

specify.output: Created 5 PDRs (PDR-008 through PDR-012) covering OAuth2 auth, bidirectional sync strategy, source badges, conflict resolution, and error handling.

plan.output: 9-task implementation plan with source reference analysis, SC-to-task mapping, and verification steps.

tasks.output: Generated detailed task list with 9 tasks, ~15 files to create/modify, 9 commits.

loop_0_implement.output: Created 004-google-tasks.sql migration with google_task_lists, google_tasks, and google_tasks_sync_state tables.

loop_1_implement.output: Created google-tasks.ts OAuth2 auth module with token exchange, refresh logic, and account management.

loop_2_implement.output: Created google-tasks-api.ts — thin googleapis wrapper for Google Tasks API v1 with CRUD operations.

loop_3_implement.output: Created google-tasks-sync.ts — bidirectional sync service with polling, sync tokens, conflict resolution, circuit breaker.

loop_4_implement.output: Created google-tasks-handlers.ts with 9 IPC channels. Updated ipc/index.ts orchestrator.

loop_5_implement.output: Updated preload/index.ts and types.d.ts with Google Tasks channels and type declarations.

loop_6_implement.output: Created TaskList.tsx component with source badges. Updated Dashboard.tsx to integrate it.

loop_7_implement.output: Created 4 unit test files with 47 tests covering API, sync, handlers, and auth. All tests pass.

loop_8_implement.output: Wired sync poller into main process lifecycle. Added sync health events. Token refresh error handling.

converge.output: All success criteria met. Typecheck passes. Tests pass (110/110). New Google Tasks files lint clean. Pre-existing lint errors in gmail-handlers.ts and oauth-server.test.ts are unrelated to this feature. No non-goals violations.
